A car mechanic is trying to loosen a wheel nut. He applies a force to the end of a spanner
(wrench) at right-angles to the spanner.
Which method provides the largest turning effect on the nut?
A
applying double the force to a spanner that is half as long
B
applying double the force to a spanner that is twice as long
C
applying double the force to the same spanner
D
applying the same force to a spanner that is twice as long

options.label: A
options.text: applying double the force to a spanner that is half as long

options.label: B
options.text: applying double the force to a spanner that is twice as long

options.label: C
options.text: applying double the force to the same spanner

options.label: D
options.text: applying the same force to a spanner that is twice as long
